notes.title: Whistling Waters is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
I'm happy to say you can finally play the full version of Whistling Waters and there is SO MUCH more content than the old demo! Share the news with your friends and [b]leave a review[/b] if you enjoy!

[b]Catch a variety[/b] of fish while steering your boat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991743/da9e7bdf44ec7718ee9ab281005c08814388dc73.png[/img]
[b]Unlock rare lures[/b], more hooks, beautiful locations, and more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991743/36f90956ee9763751c6fb5ce1676244ee5fd42be.jpg[/img]
[b]Gain your freedom[/b] and defeat the KRAKEN.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991743/9e071119a7ac4831a9fdfd7760bf5b3c63374de4.jpg[/img]


Thank you to everyone for your support. I'm pushing out small updates all week to fix bugs and more features coming soon :)
